combo_label: Around the House × Pottery & Ceramics × Alice in Wonderland

entries.clue: Sort of race run every which way, after which all must have prizes
Lidded vessel for ashes, or for tea at a village hall
Kneading the body to drive out every air bubble
Silvery fish pressing a snail to walk a little faster in a seaside song
Endless six-o'clock gathering hosted by a hare and a hatter
Chalky crust left inside a kettle in a hard water area
Words on the cake in the little glass box under the table
Wooden crosspiece under boards, spanning wall to wall to hold them up
Inner side face of a doorway, the surface a door closes against
Liquid clay used as glue, or poured into a plaster mould
Taps, a plughole, and a growing heap of washing-up
Unfired work, still dry and fragile enough to crumble
